one_changed_factor: Add one repeated explicit capability-to-purchase misstatement rule with a narrowly scoped fault-before-ad primary priority; retain ad as secondary and all other decisions
rule: At least two paired capability inquiries that the skill explicitly claims were purchase inquiries; actual purchase, quotes, and single failures excluded; a prior ad remains secondary
adoption: fill abstention or prioritize this exact explicit repeated attribution fault over an existing ad only; preserve ad and its child
retention_gate: manually verified positive net primary-path gain without previously correct path loss; otherwise candidate never enters production
grading: manual comparison only; no gold labels loaded by experiment
scope: seen development data, not an independent test set
